whatIsMissing.correctionToTheEarlierReturn: This lane's first return attributed the 403 to the session token lacking read access to the artifacts repository, and asked for that grant. That was wrong, and CAPTAIN-9H was right to reject it: the account's access to the artifacts repository is not the obstacle. The obstacle is that this session's GitHub allowlist does not include that repository, and the one call that would add it is blocked by the local permission classifier. Granting the token more GitHub access would not have moved this lane.
whatIsMissing.captainPreflightFixConfirmed: The second half of CAPTAIN-9H's message reproduces exactly. On c6d7ffe, browser_environment_exported and page_rasterizer_available are both correctly not applicable where nothing renders, giving the predicted 3 not-applicable checks. That defect is genuinely fixed and is no longer what stops this lane.

No token grant, legal change, source change or contract change is needed.
